content:
Nikhil Rao: Heads-up 1:20 UTC change window in 10m for gateway v2.7.0. Canary plan: 4% -> 25% -> 70%. Paid-cust routes pinned to v2.6.9.
Jenna Park: Pin canary to v2.7.0; rollback target v2.6.9. Please suppress autopilot auto-revert for first 15m, we want human triage.
deploy-bot: Deploybot: rollout scheduled at 21:20 UTC for gateway v2.7.0. Auto-revert suppressed per request. Health checks: p95, 5xx, route-integrity.
ops-oncall: Who has rollback authority in the first 30m?
Nikhil Rao: ops-oncall primary. I'll be on standby for approval of any global revert. Jenna will handle release notes.
Jenna Park: I'll draft the blurb now and hold publish until canary clears.
ops-oncall: Noting gating rule: p95 delta >=150ms for 3m OR route 5xx spike >0.3% => pause promo. Also block on any route-integrity mismatch.
deploy-bot: Canary started -> 4% to v2.7.0. Baseline p95=95ms, error_rate=0.02%, route_integrity_ok=true.
ops-oncall: Small jitter to 130ms after 2m, watching.
deploy-bot: Canary telemetry (21:24 UTC): p95=165ms sustained 3m, route_integrity mismatch on route /v1/process for 2 nodes. Alert: gating breach. :warning:
Nikhil Rao: Ops, looks like route mismatch could be redirect handling. Do you want a pause and traces?
ops-oncall: Opening bridge. Collecting route logs and traces:
```
infra-logs fetch --service gateway --filter "route_mismatch OR 5xx" --since 10m > /tmp/gw-route.log
```
ops-oncall: Traces show header trimming behavior changed in v2.7.0 causing 502s for certain upstreams. Given route-integrity mismatch and p95 breach, executing manual canary revert to v2.6.9 now.
ops-oncall: Running:
```
/ops/release revert --service gateway --to v2.6.9 --scope canary --confirm --note "header-trim regression"
```
deploy-bot: Revert acknowledged. Rolling canary back to v2.6.9. Traffic shifting off v2.7.0.
ops-oncall: Revert complete. Canary at 0% for v2.7.0. p95 recovered to 98ms, route_integrity OK.
Jenna Park: Holding external release note: "canary paused due to routing regression in internal tests; paid customers unaffected."
release-manager: I'll draft an internal incident stub and queue postmortem. Jenna, please coordinate wording for customer update if needed.
Nikhil Rao: Follow-ups: add header-trim unit tests to preflight, add route-integrity as a hard gating rule, and re-enable autopilot only after a smoke with header variations.
ops-oncall: Attaching /tmp/gw-route.log to ticket and leaving bridge open for 10m to monitor.
Jenna Park: Thanks team. Manual canary revert executed, release notes paused. Will update customers if product signs off. :thumbsup:
